must_contain: pub fn remove(self: Pin<&mut Self>) -> Result

tap-module-pointer-validity.obligation: Before `netlink_add_tap`, Rust must populate `netlink_tap.dev` and `netlink_tap.module` with valid pointers that outlive the registration.
tap-module-pointer-validity.preferred_discharge: Thread `&'static ThisModule` through the abstraction and write `ThisModule::as_ptr()` inside the wrapper.

tap-open-stop-balance.obligation: Open/stop shims must keep tap registration balanced and avoid double-remove on partially initialized state.
tap-open-stop-balance.preferred_discharge: Model tap state explicitly in the wrapper or rely on netdevice lifecycle invariants while keeping transitions localized.

validate-attribute-indexing.obligation: Access to `tb[IFLA_ADDRESS]` must preserve kernel indexing rules and nullability checks when surfaced to Rust.
validate-attribute-indexing.preferred_discharge: Provide a safe `NlAttrTable` accessor instead of exposing raw pointer arithmetic to driver code.
